name: Shoulder Hammer
description: Drive the shoulder into the target's chest on a short step with the whole weight behind it.

name: Hide Brace
description: Harden the skin and set the feet to take a blow on the body without giving ground.

name: Footfall Root
description: Slide the lead foot forward without lifting the weight so balance holds for the next move.

name: Sinew Whip
description: Snap the arm out from the shoulder so the sinew carries the blow past the target's guard.

name: Settling Exhale
description: Slow the breath and send qi into bruised muscle to ease the pain and close small hurts in yourself.

name: Braced Forearm
description: Raise a hardened forearm to turn a blow aside along the bone.

name: Bone Hammer
description: Bring the heavy bone of the forearm down on the target with the elbow locked.

name: Vertebra Lift
description: Straighten the spine and draw qi up it to steady the stance and add strength to your next blows.

name: Rising Knee
description: Pull the target forward and raise the knee hard into its middle.

name: Ankle Roll
description: Roll over the ankle to change direction at speed without losing the footing.

name: Shin Block
description: Turn the hardened shin to meet a low kick and stop it dead.

name: Marrow Warmth
description: Warm the long bones with qi to speed the mending of a bruise or strain in yourself or a steady ally.

name: Elbow Wedge
description: Drive the point of the elbow into a gap in the target's ribs.

name: Leather Skin
description: Fill the skin with qi until it turns blunt edges and takes a glancing hit without a mark.

name: Callus Press
description: Strike with the hardened ridge of the hand where the skin is thickest.

name: Toughened Hide
description: Tense the whole body at the instant of impact so the hide spreads the blow across the frame.

name: Open Slap
description: Swing the open hand across the target's face with the hip turning behind it.

name: Bruise Draw
description: Draw pooled blood out of a bruise with a steady press and a pulse of qi in yourself or an ally.

name: Forge Bellows
description: Draw deep belly breaths with qi following to fill your limbs with strength for several blows.

name: Blood Rush
description: Send blood and qi to the legs for a short burst of speed straight ahead.

name: Pulse Taking
description: Rest a hand on a person and read the beat of the pulse to judge hurt or fear.

name: Easing Breath
description: Slow a racing heart with long breaths so the worn body of yourself or an ally recovers its wind.

name: Heart Thump
description: Throw a short blow timed to the beat of your own pulse so the force lands whole.

name: Lung Brace
description: Fill the lungs and tighten the ribs to hold against a blow to the chest.

name: Vessel Clamp
description: Clamp a torn vessel with qi and a firm press until the bleeding in yourself or an ally stops.

name: Rallying Gasp
description: Gulp one great breath and let qi spread to the limbs to push through the next few moments of effort.

name: Forearm Maul
description: Swing the conditioned forearm in a flat arc across the target's shoulder and neck.

name: Braced Footing
description: Sink into a wide stance and hold it through a heavy push without a step back.

name: Hip Heave
description: Turn the hip under the target and heave it over to land hard on its back.

name: Sprint Drive
description: Drive off both legs in a flat sprint to close the distance in two breaths.

name: Muscle Unknot
description: Knead a pulled muscle in yourself or an ally while qi loosens the knot and eases the strain.

name: Chest Shove
description: Plant a hand on the target's chest and shove to break its footing and its balance.

name: Spine Pillar
description: Stand straight and heavy with qi sunk to the legs so a push finds no give.

name: Rising Shove
description: Rise from a crouch with both palms and lift the whole body into the target.

name: Grounded Weight
description: Sink the weight through the legs and feel the floor so each blow you throw carries more force.

name: Sunken Clinch
description: Clamp both arms around the target and sink low to pin it in place.

name: Footing Reading
description: Plant the feet and feel through the soles for the weight and the step of those nearby.

name: Weight Shift
description: Move the weight from one leg to the other in a smooth glide that carries you off the line.

name: Rib Mend
description: Press qi round cracked ribs to hold them and ease the breath of yourself or an ally.

name: Muscle Knit
description: Draw torn muscle fibres together with warm qi and steady hands on yourself or an ally.

name: Cramp Ease
description: Press the seized muscle of yourself or an ally and release it with a short pulse of qi.

name: Tendon Rest
description: Hold a strained tendon still while qi soothes the swelling around it in yourself or an ally.

name: Sudden Heel
description: Rise on the standing leg and snap the other upward into the target's middle.

name: Limb Rouse
description: Rub qi into numb limbs to wake them and bring back the strength of your grip and step.

name: Joint Setting
description: Set a wrenched joint of yourself or an ally with a firm twist and settle it with qi.

name: Heavy Lift
description: Brace the back and send qi to the arms so they bear a load several times their weight.

name: Load Hurl
description: Heave any heavy thing at hand from the hip so it flies at the target with the whole body behind it.

name: Loaded Stride
description: Take long loaded strides that keep the weight low and the pace unbroken.

name: Yoke Guard
description: Lock the shoulders and upper back into one hard bar that takes a blow across the top.

name: Trunk Squeeze
description: Wrap both arms round the target's trunk and squeeze until its breath and its strength give.

name: Rooted Stance
description: Set the feet wide and the knees bent so the whole body stands as one rooted post.

name: Dropweight Blow
description: Drop the weight into the legs and throw the blow upward from the ground through the fist.

name: Shin Sweep
description: Sweep the rear leg low and wide to cut the target's footing out from under it.

name: Heel Spin
description: Spin on the heel to face a new line without lifting the foot or losing the root.

name: Settled Roots
description: Breathe down into the legs and set the root deeper so each coming blow carries more weight.

name: Answering Brace
description: Meet an incoming shove with a braced shoulder and turn it away to the side.

name: Footfall Sense
description: Root the stance and listen with the legs to the footfalls of anyone approaching.

name: Hushed Heartbeat
description: Steady the heartbeat of yourself or an ally with slow breaths until shock and shaking fade.

name: Tallied Breath
description: Count each breath in and out so qi flows evenly and your strength lasts through a long effort.

name: Hurt Mapping
description: Feel along an ally's limbs for the place that hurts most and judge how deep the hurt runs.

name: Ribbed Guard
description: Draw the elbows to the ribs and tense the trunk so a blow to the body lands on bone.

name: Quick Jab
description: Flick the lead hand into the target's face and pull it back before it can answer.

name: Retreat Step
description: Slide the rear foot back and the front foot after it to open the distance and keep the guard.

name: Warm Blood
description: Send warmth into cold numb limbs so blood returns to them in yourself or an ally.

name: Forearm Check
description: Meet a straight blow with the edge of the forearm and push it off its line.
